og_title: Vigor Boost Price: Cost Per Day, Packs and Guarantee
desc: Vigor Boost price explained: the 2, 3 and 6-bottle packs, real cost per day, why there's no subscription and how the 60-day guarantee fits each order size.
h1_b: What Each Pack Really Costs Per Day
subhead: Three package sizes, one gummy a day and a 60-day guarantee. Here's the math per day and per month, which order size makes sense first, and where buying elsewhere can cost you the refund.
alt: Person reading a book in a parked car, for our Vigor Boost Price article

body: The Vigor Boost price at the time of writing was $79 per bottle for 2 bottles ($158 plus shipping), $69 per bottle for 3 ($207, free US shipping) and $49 per bottle for 6 ($294, free US shipping). With 30 gummies per bottle at one a day, that's about $2.63, $2.30 or $1.63 per day. Every order is a one-time charge.

Those numbers come from the official order page and can change, so treat them as a snapshot. The rest of this page is about using them well: what each pack costs per month, how the 60-day guarantee lines up with each order size, why third-party listings are a risk and whether the price makes sense for what's in the gummy. For the formula and verdict, see our Vigor Boost review.
How much does Vigor Boost cost?
The official store offers three bundles. There's no single-bottle option listed on the order page at the time of writing, so the smallest order is two bottles, a 60-day supply.

The 2-bottle pack adds shipping at checkout. The 3- and 6-bottle packs list free US shipping. Shipping charges, taxes and international availability can differ, so look at the final total on the checkout screen before you pay, not just the per-bottle number.
What's the Vigor Boost price per day?

The serving is one gummy once daily, and each bottle holds 30, so one bottle is one month. That keeps the arithmetic clean. Divide the order total by the number of gummies and you have your daily cost.

The 6-bottle pack cuts the daily cost by roughly 38% compared with the 2-bottle pack. That's a real saving if you know you'll keep taking it. The catch is the word "if," which the next sections deal with.
What does that come to per year?

If you stuck with Vigor Boost for a full year, buying 6-bottle packs twice would cost about $588. Buying 2-bottle packs six times would cost $948 plus shipping on each order. Before committing to either, it's worth knowing whether the gummy does anything for you, which is what the guarantee window is for.
What does it cost per milligram?

Here's a less flattering way to read the same numbers. Each gummy carries 82 mg of actives. At $2.63 a day you're paying about 3.2 cents per milligram of blend. At $1.63 it's about 2 cents. That number isn't meaningful on its own, but it explains why single-ingredient powders look so cheap by comparison: they sell grams, and this sells milligrams wrapped in a gummy.
Is there a Vigor Boost subscription?

No subscription or autoship appears on the official order page. Each package is billed once. That's worth pointing out because surprise recurring charges are one of the most common complaints in the men's supplement market, and many "free trial" offers quietly enroll buyers in monthly shipments.

Still, read the checkout page before you submit. Look for any pre-ticked box offering extra bottles or add-on products, and check that the total matches the package you chose. Your bank statement should show one charge for the order.
Shipping on the 2-bottle pack. It's added at checkout, so the true daily cost is a bit above $2.63.
Upsell screens. Some checkouts offer extra products after payment. Accept only what you actually want.
Return shipping on a refund. If the refund terms ask you to send bottles back at your own cost, that comes out of what you recover.
Currency and card fees if you order from outside the US.
None of these is unusual for direct-to-consumer supplements. They're simply easier to handle when you know they're coming, and they change which pack looks cheapest once everything is added up.
Which Vigor Boost pack should you buy first?

It depends on how sure you are, and for a first order, most people shouldn't be very sure. There's no clinical trial on the gummy, and the 82 mg blend is small compared with research doses of its ingredients. Our does Vigor Boost work page walks through that evidence. With that in mind:
2 bottles covers the full 60-day guarantee window at the lowest upfront cost. It's the most cautious choice, but the most expensive per day.
3 bottles gives 90 days at a lower daily price with free shipping. You'd decide within the first 60 days whether to keep going, with a month in reserve.
6 bottles makes sense for someone who has already taken Vigor Boost, liked it and plans to continue. As a first order, it's the biggest bet on an untested product.
Three bottles of Vigor Boost gummies, the 3-bottle pack in this Vigor Boost price comparison
The 3-bottle pack covers 90 days, which leaves room to judge results inside the 60-day guarantee window.
For most first-time buyers, the 3-bottle pack is the reasonable middle. It lowers the daily cost noticeably without committing you to six months of a supplement you haven't tried.

There's also a group for whom the right pack is none. If you take nitrates, ED medication or blood pressure drugs, have thyroid or liver disease, or are very sensitive to caffeine, get your doctor's view before spending anything. The money-back guarantee refunds the purchase, not a bad reaction. Our Vigor Boost side effects guide lists the interactions in detail.
How does the 60-day guarantee work with each pack?
Orders through the official checkout come with a 60-day money-back guarantee. The timing matters more than the headline:
With 2 bottles, the guarantee covers almost the entire supply.
With 3 bottles, you'll have about a month's supply left when the window closes.
With 6 bottles, the window ends when you're only a third of the way through.

Read the current refund terms on the official site before ordering. Check whether you need to return bottles, including opened ones, who pays return shipping and how to start a request. Keep your order confirmation email, note your delivery date and set a calendar reminder for about day 45. Decide by then, so you're not racing the deadline.

One practical tip: don't throw away empty bottles until the window has closed. Some refund policies ask for them back, and you can't return what you've recycled. Keep the outer box and packing slip too, since they make it easy to match the return to your order.
How to use the window well

Pick two or three things to rate weekly, such as afternoon energy and interest in sex, and write the scores down from the first day. If nothing has moved by week six, request the refund. Writing it down protects you from the sunk-cost feeling that makes people keep taking something because they've already paid for it.
Where to buy Vigor Boost: is it on Amazon?
Vigor Boost is sold through its official website. We'd buy it there and only there, for three reasons.
The guarantee. The 60-day money-back guarantee applies to orders through the official checkout. Third-party sellers usually aren't covered.
Authenticity. Men's vitality supplements are among the most counterfeited products online. The FDA has found many sexual enhancement products with hidden prescription drugs.
Freshness and storage. The label says to store between 59 and 86 degrees F. A marketplace seller's warehouse might not.

If you see Vigor Boost on Amazon, eBay, Walmart's marketplace or a discount site at a much lower price, be wary. A price far below the official one often means old stock, a reseller with no refund obligation or something that isn't the real product. Our where to buy Vigor Boost guide goes further into spotting fakes.
Why do Vigor Boost prices differ between websites?

Search for the product and you'll see a spread of numbers. Some review pages quote older prices, some show a banner discount that's really the 6-bottle rate presented as a sale, and a few list prices for marketplace sellers that aren't the manufacturer. Countdown timers and "only today" badges on third-party pages are marketing, not information.

The only price that counts is the one on the official checkout when you place the order. Everything on this page, including our own numbers, is a snapshot from the time of writing. If the official price has moved, the per-day method still works: take the total you'd pay, including shipping, and divide by the number of gummies in the order.
What are you paying for in each gummy?

This is the question most price pages skip. Each gummy contains an 82 mg proprietary blend of nine ingredients: muira puama, ashwagandha, maca, catuaba, green tea extract, caffeine (10 mg), L-arginine, tribulus and horny goat weed. The label says the blend is equivalent to about 567 mg of dry powders, which describes the plant material used to make the extracts, not the amount you swallow.

At $1.63 to $2.63 a day, you're paying for convenience and a mix of traditional botanicals, not for research-level doses. Plain maca powder or a standardized ashwagandha capsule with a printed dose usually costs less per day and delivers the amounts used in studies. What you give up is the single daily gummy and the multi-herb mix. Our Vigor Boost ingredients breakdown shows how little room each herb has in the blend.
Is Vigor Boost cheaper than HorseBoost?

The two gummies share the same 82 mg active blend, so it's fair to compare them on price. At the time of writing they used the same pack structure: 2 bottles at $79, 3 at $69 and 6 at $49 per bottle, with the bigger packs shipping free. Shipping on the smallest pack can differ between the two stores, so compare final totals at checkout.

The real differences are small. HorseBoost lists 5 mg of caffeine versus 10 mg, 3 g of sugar versus 2 g, and a strawberry flavor. If you're caffeine-sensitive, the lower dose might tip it. Otherwise you're choosing on taste. Our Vigor Boost vs HorseBoost comparison puts the labels side by side.
Is Vigor Boost worth the price?

It depends on what you're buying it for. As a pleasant daily habit with familiar botanicals and a mild hint of caffeine, $1.63 to $2.63 a day is in the normal range for branded gummies. As a way to get proven doses of maca or ashwagandha, it's poor value, because the blend can't hold them.

Put another way, the same $207 for a 3-bottle order could buy a few months of plain maca powder, a basic set of dumbbells or most of a year of a budget gym. Those aren't either-or choices, and plenty of men do all of them. But if the budget is tight, the habits with the best evidence for energy and sexual health are exercise, sleep, less alcohol and a healthy weight. A gummy is the optional extra, not the foundation.

And if the reason you're shopping is a change in erections, the most valuable money you can spend is on a doctor's visit. New or persistent erection problems can be an early sign of heart disease, diabetes or low testosterone, and those are treatable. A checkup costs about the same as a 3-bottle order and tells you far more. More on that in our men's health section.

Low energy plus a fading sex drive is also a classic pattern of low testosterone, which a simple morning blood test can check. Our guide to low testosterone in men lists the symptoms that justify asking for one. If the result is normal, you've ruled something out for the price of a lab visit, and you can try a gummy with clearer expectations.
faq: Can I buy just one bottle of Vigor Boost?
At the time of writing the official order page listed only 2-, 3- and 6-bottle packages. Check the official page, since offers can change.
Is Vigor Boost cheaper with a coupon code?

We haven't seen an official coupon code. Sites that advertise codes are often affiliate pages, and the multi-bottle packs are already the discounted option. Check the official checkout for the current price.
Does Vigor Boost charge sales tax?
That depends on your state and the checkout. Look at the final total on the checkout screen before you pay, which includes any tax and shipping.
How long does Vigor Boost shipping take?
Delivery times aren't printed on the label. Check the official site for current shipping estimates, and note your delivery date so you know when the 60-day guarantee window ends.
Does Vigor Boost ship outside the US?
The free shipping on the 3- and 6-bottle packs applies to US orders. International availability and costs, if offered, will show at checkout.
What payment methods can I use?
Payment options are shown on the official checkout page. Paying with a credit card gives you an extra layer of protection if an order goes wrong.
It may. Prices on this page were published at the time of writing. The cost-per-day method works with any price: divide the order total by the number of gummies.
final_p: One-time charge, no subscription and a 60-day money-back guarantee on orders through the official checkout. See current Vigor Boost packages.
